tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Return readable text for a public http(s) URL. Reuses a stored copy if it is newer than max_age_s. Includes sha256 hash and fetched_at. Needs a funded API key on this HTTP request.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description: Search pages already stored in AfterImage. Does not visit the live web. Then call get_page for the full text of a hit. Needs a funded API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page · Private data: get_page, search_pages · Public sink: get_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page · Private data: get_page, search_pages · Public sink: get_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
